situation: An audit team testing a client's year-end trade receivables by confirmation.
complication: Some customers disagree with the client's balances and others have not replied.
key_question: What do the confirmation results show, and what must be done before the engagement team concludes?

titles.options: Two ways to complete the receivables testing.
titles.recommendation: Resolve the exceptions and test the non-replies first.
titles.roadmap: Finish the follow-up before fieldwork closes, then hand over.
titles.kpis: Two measures show the testing is complete.
titles.risks: The main risk is concluding before exceptions are explained.

figures.label: Disagreements as a share of value sampled

issue_tree.finding: Some customers disagree with the client's balances.
points: Projected simply, that is about [F10] against materiality of [F11].

hypotheses.text: The differences are timing items such as cash in transit.

issue_tree.so_what: Each difference needs an explanation before any projection is relied on.

issue_tree.finding: Some balances have no confirmation yet.
issue_tree.so_what: Alternative procedures are needed for every non-reply.

options.name: Follow up first
options.description: Investigate each disagreement and test non-replies with later cash and invoices.

options.name: Extend the sample now
options.description: Send more confirmations before the exceptions are explained.

recommendation.rationale: Explained differences may shrink the [F10] projection, and the work is needed either way; the engagement team decides any conclusion or extension.

actions: Ask the client to reconcile each disagreement and gather support.
Test non-replies against later cash receipts and invoices.
Hand the engagement manager the results before fieldwork closes, for a decision on extending the sample.
File the working papers for the partner's review.
Note what to change in next year's confirmation planning.

risks.risk: Differences turn out to be real misstatements.
risks.mitigation: Report them to the engagement manager as soon as found.

risks.risk: The client cannot support its balances.
risks.mitigation: Escalate to the engagement manager before fieldwork closes.
